run_uma_1p2_surgery_cli: run the uma_1p2_surgery CLI with --checkpoint-in and --output-dir to perform checkpoint surgery
run_uma_1p2_surgery_function: run uma_1p2_surgery to produce stage1 and stage2 checkpoint files from a given checkpoint path
add_omat_rattle_support: add omat_rattle dataset support to a UMA 1.2 checkpoint by cloning omat embeddings
remove_omat_rattle: remove omat_rattle from a checkpoint config and resize expert weights from 8 to 7 slots
compare_checkpoints: compare two checkpoint files across all tasks and PBC/non-PBC systems for energy and force differences
